mapper.update: udpate pro_yt_product_specification_supplier set is_deleted=1 WHERE specification_id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT pss.*,s.name as supplierName,s.code as supplierCode, (select code from pro_yt_product where id=(select product_id from pro_yt_product_specification where id=pss.specification_id)) as productCode
FROM pur_yt_supplier s left JOIN pro_yt_product_specification_supplier pss ON s.id = pss.supplier_id WHERE pss.id = #{id}

select pypss.*,pys.name as supplierName from pro_yt_product_specification_supplier as pypss left join pur_yt_supplier as pys on pys.id = pypss.supplier_id where specification_id=#{specificationId} and pypss.is_deleted=0

SELECT p.id, p.supplier_id, p.specification_id, p.supplier_specification, p.min_number, p.supplier_price, ps.name as supplierName, ps.code as supplierCode FROM pro_yt_product_specification_supplier p LEFT JOIN pur_yt_supplier ps ON p.supplier_id = ps.id WHERE p.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND p.is_deleted = 0
